body.says: Something pure that gathers from the field, given what it takes: glass's own, evaluated by the engine, or one's own, an expression over what it is given. An expression calls a function, and is evaluated wherever it is used, as in what is drawn, so nothing it gives is kept; a function kept as a favorite is a way of looking one can return to.

gives.says: For a function of one's own, the expression it gives, each argument it was given named as { arg: i }.

native.says: For one of glass's own, the name the engine evaluates it by.

says.says: What it gathers, in a sentence.

takes.says: What it is given, each in turn: a set, any number of sets, words, a store's key, or an axis to group by; nothing unless it says.

body.says: A call: a component and what it gives it to draw, holons in order or a way of looking. One holon is drawn as itself, several as a list, a way of looking as what it gathers. A mount is the one thing that stands still to be changed, so the root of what one looks at is a mount. Where it looks is the page's address, and what the reader keeps in it is their own.

argument.says: What the component is given, where it is given holons: holons in order.

component.says: The component the mount calls, when it names one; otherwise one is found for what it is given.

gathers.says: What the component is given, where it is given a way of looking: the expression itself, held in the mount, so a place one looks at needs no holon of its own.

offer.says: What the mount offers everything it draws, nearer offers shadowing it: settings a component takes and its slot leaves unsaid, by their names, and what components look for, as the favorites, or the search a mount's menu is drawn by.

body.says: Where one has looked, in order: each visit when it was and what was looked at, said as an expression's text, so a visit points at nothing that can be gone. Each move adds a visit; nothing is rewritten, and going back adds none.

A holon that declares the types it takes and draws what it is given, opening space in it where what it holds is drawn in turn by the components that match. It is made of code, or of data: mounts held as its template.

argument.says: What a mount of it is given: one holon, a list of holons, a selection, either, or a way of looking, with the list it gathers; one holon unless it says otherwise.

code.says: The module the interface runs, as JavaScript, for a component made of code.

kinds.says: The kinds of slot it draws in, by their names: full or face.

reads.says: The reads it makes of the field beyond what it is handed, by their forms, as holders or instances: what it may look at, said where it can be seen. None unless it says.

says.says: What it draws, in a sentence.

settings.says: The settings it takes from the slot that opens it, each said in prose with its shape, as a type declares its fields; none unless it says.

takes.says: The names of the types whose instances it draws; none means it draws any holon, when nothing closer matches.

template.says: Its mounts, in order, each given what the component itself was given, where it is made of data: the component a mount calls, and the kind of slot it is.

body.says: A kind of slot: how what stands in a slot is drawn, said between the one that holds it and the one held, so neither has to know the other.

says.says: How what stands in a slot of this kind is drawn, in a sentence.

body.says: What everything drawn is made of: the colours, the type, the measure and the spacing, named once so every component draws with the same material.

css.says: The style sheet it lays: the names every component draws with, and the page's own ground and type.

says.says: What the material is, in a sentence.

body.says: Every holon in the field.
The instances of the types given.
What the holons given hold, as parts.
What holds the holons given.
What the holons given point at, without holding.
What points at the holons given, without holding.
What contains each of the words given.
What is called by each of the words given.
What the store given holds.
Every type.
What every set given holds.
What any set given holds.
Everything but the set given.
The set given, in collections along an axis: type, parent, store, or auto, whichever splits it best.
Drawn whole, as the place one stands in.
Seen from outside, by what it is at a glance, and entered to go in.
Glass's own material: a warm ground in light and dark, a serif to read in, a sans around the reading, and a short measure.
A mount: what it gives, holons or a way of looking, drawn by the component it calls, offered what it offers; where it may be written, a press inside it moves it.

place.says: Where it looks, as the page's address says. A mount given no place is one found within what another draws, and is shown rather than run.

body.says: A type: what its instances are, each field it declares with what it means and its shape, and its instances.
Any holon nothing closer draws: what it is an instance of, and every value it holds, each reference a slot offered a face; as a face, its name and types.
